name: Roland FANTOM-06/07/08
description: Roland FANTOM-06, FANTOM-07 and FANTOM-08 workstations: the temporary scene (common, effects, and the zone, zone EQ and zone control blocks of all 16 zones) with zone 1's Z-Core, SN-A, EXSN and Model tones and drum kit, the VTW organ tone, and the system settings. From the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: FANTOM-06/07/08 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Feb 1, 2022)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from FANTOM-06_07_08_MIDI_Imple_eng01_W.pdf (sha256 60d16501a45281f50dd8834a944e1c2339b26befe27cdca50b1d367673a3bdde). Model ID 00 00 00 5B, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

One profile answers FANTOM-06, -07 and -08: they share the address map, the model id (00 00 00 5B) and the identity family code and number (5B 03, 00 01); only the first software-revision byte tells them apart (p11).
The model id 00 00 00 5B is the FANTOM-6/7/8's and the FANTOM EX's too; the identity reply's family number (00 01) is what is this instrument's own.

Scene-level blocks for all 16 zones (Zone, Zone EQ, Zone Control); tones for zone 1 only: Z-Core at 02 10 00 00, drum kit at 02 30 00 00 with its instruments at 03 00 00 00, SN-A at 04 00 00 00, EXSN at 05 00 00 00, Model at 05 20 00 00, and the one VTW tone at 04 40 00 00.
Zone 1's drum-kit instruments cover keys 36-72; keys 21-35 and 73-108 are the same Inst blocks every 00 05 00 from 03 00 00 00 and are left out to keep the profile near 12,000 parameters.

Many rows are printed without a number where they repeat: Name (16 bytes, as 16 rows), the two LFOs of a Partial LFO block, the 16 LFO steps, the four partials of a PMT, the four matrix controls of a partial, the four waves of a drum instrument. The generator numbers them in printed order.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel transmits (CC, RPN) is not in the address map
coverage.scenePresets: Scene banks A and B only: the Bank Select table (p1) continues past B with ":" and does not say how far
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX/IFX/TFX, chorus, reverb, VTW overdrive and rotary parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.zoneTones: zone 1 only: the tones of zones 2-16 are the same tables at Z-Core 02 11 00 00 - 02 1F 00 00 (step 01 00 00), Drum Kit 02 32 00 00 - 02 4E 00 00 (step 02 00 00), Drum Kit Inst Set 03 04 00 00 - 03 3C 00 00 (step 04 00 00), SN-A 04 01 00 00 - 04 0F 00 00, EXSN 05 01 00 00 - 05 0F 00 00 and Model 05 21 00 00 - 05 2F 00 00 (step 01 00 00), and are not laid out. The one VTW tone (04 40 00 00) is
coverage.drumInstruments: zone 1's drum kit has every key's partial and partial EQ (keys 21-108); its instruments (Inst Common and the three Inst envelopes) only for keys 36-72. Keys 21-35 (03 00 00 00 - 03 00 46 00) and 73-108 (03 02 04 00 - 03 03 33 00) are left out
